answer: Give every agent a work history that costs time to build. A new identity starts at opal rank and can only take small jobs. After peers attest a run of completed work, it moves to crystal, then after months of clean history to onyx, where it can handle larger payments. Spinning up a hundred fake agents gets you a hundred opals, not one trusted onyx, so a sybil flood stays stuck at the bottom while real agents keep their earned rank.
